notes.title: It's time for Zulin Time!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

My new game, which I've been developing for just under three years, is being released! If you're interested, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1047430/Zulin_Time/]don't forget to follow the link![/url] 
Thank you for your attention and have a good day!

Regards, Mikhail

notes.title: "SORE" version 1.1.4 available!
notes.notes:

[list]
[*] Finally, the game stably runs on Windows 7 x64
[*] Fixed a collision of the brick, now clicking on it will be easier
[*] removed debug-mode, which run when you press F12
[/list]
Thanks for playing and have a good day! ]:ɔ

notes.title: The bug that occurs in Win7x64 users is cured.
notes.notes:
I was able to identify and correct the error that arose for users with the operating system Win7x64. The error was manifested in the fact that in the status of the Steam the game was "running", but in fact - no. Also the game was compiled  for two different processor architectures. Please, reinstall the current version of the game. Steam automatically download the correct version depending on your processor type. Thank you for your patience!
Have a good game!

notes.title: A small, test update, without version.
notes.notes:
Hi there!

A number of people noticed a strange phenomenon, which can be described as "running the application in a Steam", which in fact - is not running. Frankly, I am very confused, moreover, I have no idea why this is happening. Everything complicates the fact that the game does not "crash" and does not send me buglist.

I decided embed game to older nwjs "shell". I think this will help.

[h1] Please completely re-install the game, and also delete the game folder (SORE) at the following address: [/h1]

[i]C:\Users\UserName\AppData\Local\SORE[/i]

P.S. Please let me know if this does not help.
